script_text: Pisces, a fierce Mars‑Neptune opposition just ignited your 7th House of Partnerships. Transiting Mars in Virgo opposes your ruling planet Neptune in Pisces, pulling the 1st House of Self into a tug‑of‑war with the 7th House of Relationships. This tense aspect blurs boundaries, fuels passive‑aggressive impulses, and clouds clear communication. Your watery Pisces nature heightens the fog, so grounding practices become essential today. If you’re coupled, expect sudden misunderstandings that feel like fog — speak plainly before resentment builds. Singles, the opposition magnetizes a magnetic but elusive suitor; trust your intuition over surface charm. Mars also squares your 10th House of Career in Sagittarius, so delay signing contracts or launching new projects until the aspect separates mid‑week. Beware of over‑idealizing a partner’s promises — reality will bite back when the haze lifts. Subscribe so you don’t miss what’s coming for Pisces this week.
